content:
In career development and leadership, alignment is everything. Others can provide frameworks, feedback, and advice—but they cannot give you your core direction.

Only you know what you truly want out of your work and life.

Trust your internal compass, define your vision, and take complete ownership of the path forward.

title: Permission seeking has diluted your senses
content: Permission seeking has diluted your senses. Operate with sovereign authority or watch your leverage evaporate.
